section_summary.extract_value: This section contains a reference to a journal article by Andrew, Tiggemann, & Clark (2014). An accompanying figure, Fig. 1, illustrates three indirect effect models (Panels A, B, C) all based on a sample size of N=84, examining predictors of Body Appreciation. The figure presents beta coefficients, not correlations, and does not specify the assessment instruments for Body Appreciation or BMI.
